children: Jain brings more than two decades of finance experience across Bharti Airtel, Zomato, MobiKwik and Advantage Club
SquadStack.ai has appointed Saurabh Jain as Head of Finance and Legal, with responsibility for financial planning, controllership, commercial structuring, legal and compliance functions.

Jain brings more than two decades of finance experience across consumer businesses. He has held senior finance roles at Bharti Airtel and Zomato, led finance for MobiKwik's wallet business and most recently served as Chief Financial Officer at Advantage Club.
A Chartered Accountant, Jain qualified with an All India Rank of 48 and is a commerce graduate from Shri Ram College of Commerce, Delhi University.

In his new role, Jain will oversee the company's finance and legal functions as it scales its business and revenue. His responsibilities will include financial planning, financial controls, commercial structuring and legal and compliance matters.
SquadStack.ai currently handles more than 50 lakh AI calls a day for over 60 consumer brands, according to the company.
The appointment comes as the company expands its leadership team, with senior roles also being recruited across sales, product and customer success.
Jain said he would focus on building the finance and legal functions and strengthening financial and operational processes as the company expands.
